system.specialAbility:
You belong to the Greenblood Elf Bloodline.

Woodland Passage. Your Moves ignore Difficult Terrain caused by nonmagical undergrowth, roots, and low branches. This does not permit a Step into Difficult Terrain or ignore Greater Difficult Terrain, a solid barrier, or damage from a hazard.
system.description: A bloodline of the Elf ancestry. Its Root Talent is granted free by the character-creation choice.
